project.title: Whole-genome sequencing of Escherichia coli S4 from retail fish wastewater in Dhaka, Bangladesh
project.description: This project characterizes Escherichia coli strain S4 isolated from retail fish wastewater at Rai Shaheb Bazar, Dhaka, Bangladesh. Paired-end whole-genome sequencing and draft genome assembly support environmental antimicrobial resistance surveillance and comparative genomic research. The project includes raw sequencing reads and the draft genome assembly from a single bacterial isolate.

samples: Escherichia coli strain S4 isolated from retail fish wastewater in Dhaka, Bangladesh
runs: Whole-genome sequencing of Escherichia coli S4 from retail fish wastewater
